end.summary:
Discussed earthworms, ants, leaf litter, and soil animal roles.
Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
Practised how soil animals turn dead leaves into rich soil.
Pihu repeatedly said earthworms spoil soil and crops; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised earthworm tunnels and how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. Pihu identified earthworms and ants as soil animals and connected leaf litter with leaves under trees, in parks, or gardens. They continued to mix up earthworms with harmful pests, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, look under fallen leaves together and ask Pihu to say one way earthworms help soil.
